hunger.line: No need for greed or hunger
stanza: No need for greed or hunger

hunger.songTitle: You Don’t Care for Me Enough to Cry
hunger.line: A drug to kill the hunger
stanza: Oh, I miss your holy shoutin'
These days I can't make you make a sound
Take me to the times when
We'd look up to the skies and
Climb up there and draw the thunder down
But darling, I can't help the way I feel
A drug to kill the hunger
And ease the awful pain of living here

hunger.line: Bagging, with a life’s-worth of hunger
hunger.linePrev: Now her coat drags through the water

hunger.line: I was salted by your hunger
stanza: I was salted by your hunger
Now you've gone and lost your appetite
And a little bird is every bit as handy in a fight
I am lonely as a memory
Despite the gathering round the fire
Aren't you every bird on every wire?

hunger.songTitle: In the Heat of the Summer
stanza: "For shame, for shame," wrote the papers
Now the rubble's resting on your broken streets
So see what your rage has unraveled"
Like the damp grass that yields to me
Like these insects that feast on me
And yours among them, I know

younger.line: Desperado, woah, you ain't gettin' no younger
stanza: Desperado, woah, you ain't gettin' no younger
Your pain and your hunger, they're drivin' you home
And freedom, oh, freedom, well, that's just some people talkin'
Your prison is walkin' through this world all alone

younger.line: Do you remember how when you were younger
stanza: Do you remember how when you were younger
Days  disappeared into months, into years
